name: GraalVM Community Edition native-image runtime (Substrate VM and JDK class libraries)
scope: native-image executables only (not the JVM/JAR distributions)
note: The native executables are built with GraalVM Community 25.0.0 and embed its runtime. The software as a whole is released under GPL version 2 with the Classpath Exception, which permits linking this runtime into an executable under a different licence.
